messages:
maya: Hey — trying to track down traces + logs for a failed batch inference run: job id `batch-2026-03-16-87`. Where's the canonical dashboard or quick queries for per-model latency and the trace id? Also need the worker pod logs (k8s).
sam: For batch runs we have the 'Batch inference overview' dashboard in Grafana. It links to Tempo traces from the latency panels. Shortlink: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd1234/batch-inference-overview (viewer role).
sam: For Loki the quick query I use is: ``{job=\"batch-inference\", cluster=\"prod\"} |= \"batch-2026-03-16-87\"`` that should narrow to the pods that processed that job.
maya: Nice, thanks. I don't have grafana access to that folder — 403 when I open the shortlink.
leo: @maya I can grant you Viewer on the "batch-run-views" folder. Do you want temporary access or permanent?
maya: Temporary is fine — just for debugging this run.
leo: Ok; I'll add you now. You should get an email. If not, tell me and I'll share a snapshot link.
hana: If you pull a trace id from the logs you can open it in Tempo like: https://tempo.redwood.internal/trace/<TRACE_ID> — the trace will show the model scoring spans and any KV cache hits/misses.
maya: Where in the logs is the trace id? I only see a couple of x-request-id fields.
sam: The batch runner emits `trace_id` in the worker stdout line that looks like: ``[2026-03-16T14:32:01Z] INFO job=batch-2026-03-16-87 trace_id=4f2a1b... model=gpt-medium span=invoke`` — search Loki for `trace_id=` if `job=` is noisy.
maya: Great — found `trace_id=4f2a1b2c`. Opening tempo now.
ops-bot: Deployment notice: batch-runner v2.9.1 rolled out to prod at 2026-03-16T13:50Z (no impact reported).
hana: FYI if you want per-model breakdowns use the dashboard's 'per-model latency' panel and expand the legend. Panels have a direct link-to-trace icon (Tempo) on hover.
maya: Leo, I accepted the Grafana invite but still can't see the folder — 403 persists.
leo: Huh. Can you DM me the exact error screenshot? We might need the org-level role. If it's faster, I'll create a temporary team token and paste a snapshot link.
sam: Long-term: eng-ml folks should have Viewer on the observability org. @leo can we add a group (eng-ml-view) instead of manual grants?
leo: Yup, that's the plan — will open a small access request to eng-platform backlog and add the group. Meanwhile @maya I'll PM the snapshot link.
maya: Got it — accessed the snapshot, traced the error to a model preload span showing high serialization time. Thanks all — will follow up with a short postmortem once I check a few more jobs. :thumbsup:
